theorems.name: alarm_fires_high
theorems.doc: **S (U1).** With an admitted configuration the high alarm sounds at any reading at or above `hi_on`, whatever its state.
theorems.statement:
theorem alarm_fires_high (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (b : AlarmBands)
    (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) (ht : b.hi_on.val ≤ t.val) :
    alarm_next on t b = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem alarm_fires_high (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (b : AlarmBands)
    (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) (ht : b.hi_on.val ≤ t.val) :
    alarm_next on t b = ok true := by
  have := alarm_valid_facts b hv
  unfold alarm_next
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: alarm_fires_low
theorems.doc: **S (U1).** … and the low alarm at any reading at or below `lo_on`.
theorems.statement:
theorem alarm_fires_low (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (b : AlarmBands)
    (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) (ht : t.val ≤ b.lo_on.val) :
    alarm_next on t b = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem alarm_fires_low (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (b : AlarmBands)
    (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) (ht : t.val ≤ b.lo_on.val) :
    alarm_next on t b = ok true := by
  have := alarm_valid_facts b hv
  unfold alarm_next
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: alarm_reachable
theorems.doc: **S (U1).** Both alarm thresholds lie inside the sensor's range, so there is a reading for each that sounds it (upstream accepts `max_safe_temp = 1000`, which no reading reaches).
theorems.statement:
theorem alarm_reachable (b : AlarmBands) (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) :
    b.hi_on.val ≤ 2000 ∧ -880 ≤ b.lo_on.val
theorems.proof:
theorem alarm_reachable (b : AlarmBands) (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) :
    b.hi_on.val ≤ 2000 ∧ -880 ≤ b.lo_on.val := by
  have := alarm_valid_facts b hv
  omega

theorems.name: alarm_clears
theorems.doc: **S (U1).** In the quiet band the alarm is off, whatever its state, and an admitted configuration has a quiet band (upstream with `2·h ≥ max − min` keeps it on forever once it fired).
theorems.statement:
theorem alarm_clears (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (b : AlarmBands)
    (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) (h1 : b.lo_off.val < t.val) (h2 : t.val < b.hi_off.val) :
    alarm_next on t b = ok false ∧ b.lo_off.val + 1 < b.hi_off.val
theorems.proof:
theorem alarm_clears (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (b : AlarmBands)
    (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) (h1 : b.lo_off.val < t.val) (h2 : t.val < b.hi_off.val) :
    alarm_next on t b = ok false ∧ b.lo_off.val + 1 < b.hi_off.val := by
  have := alarm_valid_facts b hv
  refine ⟨?_, by omega⟩
  unfold alarm_next
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: alarm_hysteresis
theorems.doc: **S.** An admitted configuration has a non-negative hysteresis: the "on" thresholds lie outside the "stay on" thresholds.
theorems.statement:
theorem alarm_hysteresis (b : AlarmBands) (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) :
    b.lo_on.val ≤ b.lo_off.val ∧ b.hi_off.val ≤ b.hi_on.val
theorems.proof:
theorem alarm_hysteresis (b : AlarmBands) (hv : alarm_valid b = ok true) :
    b.lo_on.val ≤ b.lo_off.val ∧ b.hi_off.val ≤ b.hi_on.val := by
  have := alarm_valid_facts b hv
  omega

theorems.name: fan_on_above
theorems.doc: **C.** The fan is on at or above `on_at`.
theorems.statement:
theorem fan_on_above (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (f : FanBands) (ht : f.on_at.val ≤ t.val) :
    fan_next on t f = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem fan_on_above (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (f : FanBands) (ht : f.on_at.val ≤ t.val) :
    fan_next on t f = ok true := by
  unfold fan_next
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: fan_off_below
theorems.doc: **S.** With an admitted fan configuration it is off at or below `off_at` (no reading is both above `on_at` and below `off_at`).
theorems.statement:
theorem fan_off_below (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (f : FanBands)
    (hv : fan_valid f = ok true) (ht : t.val ≤ f.off_at.val) :
    fan_next on t f = ok false
theorems.proof:
theorem fan_off_below (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (f : FanBands)
    (hv : fan_valid f = ok true) (ht : t.val ≤ f.off_at.val) :
    fan_next on t f = ok false := by
  have := fan_valid_facts f hv
  unfold fan_next
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: fan_holds_between
theorems.doc: **C.** Between the thresholds the fan keeps its state (hysteresis).
theorems.statement:
theorem fan_holds_between (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (f : FanBands)
    (h1 : f.off_at.val < t.val) (h2 : t.val < f.on_at.val) :
    fan_next on t f = ok on
theorems.proof:
theorem fan_holds_between (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (f : FanBands)
    (h1 : f.off_at.val < t.val) (h2 : t.val < f.on_at.val) :
    fan_next on t f = ok on := by
  unfold fan_next
  split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> scalar_tac

AlarmBands.lean:
structure AlarmBands where
  hi_on : Std.I32
  hi_off : Std.I32
  lo_on : Std.I32
  lo_off : Std.I32

fan_valid.lean:
def fan_valid (f : FanBands) : Result Bool := do
  if SENSOR_MIN <= f.off_at
  then if f.off_at < f.on_at
       then ok (f.on_at <= SENSOR_MAX)
       else ok false
  else ok false

FanBands.lean:
structure FanBands where
  on_at : Std.I32
  off_at : Std.I32

alarm_valid.lean:
def alarm_valid (b : AlarmBands) : Result Bool := do
  if SENSOR_MIN <= b.lo_on
  then
    if b.lo_on <= b.lo_off
    then
      if b.lo_off < b.hi_off
      then
        let i ← b.lo_off + 1#i32
        if i < b.hi_off
        then
          if b.hi_off <= b.hi_on
          then ok (b.hi_on <= SENSOR_MAX)
          else ok false
        else ok false
      else ok false
    else ok false
  else ok false

alarm_next.lean:
def alarm_next (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (b : AlarmBands) : Result Bool := do
  if on
  then if t >= b.hi_off
       then ok true
       else ok (t <= b.lo_off)
  else if t >= b.hi_on
       then ok true
       else ok (t <= b.lo_on)

fan_next.lean:
def fan_next (on : Bool) (t : Std.I32) (f : FanBands) : Result Bool := do
  if t >= f.on_at
  then ok true
  else if t <= f.off_at
       then ok false
       else ok on
